WEEK 5 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Jake, 145.9-124.3; Shaq def. Adam, 112.0-99.9; Fronge def. Drew, 158.0-94.0 (BLOWOUT); Charles def. Mitchum, 201.4-105.1 (BLOWOUT); Kevin def. Brent, 150.1-146.2 (NAIL-BITER); Ryan def. Wingard, 174.4-87.9 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week 5 final thought before we pivot to Week 6: Charles put up 201.4 points against Mitchum. Not a win. A statement filed with the league office in triplicate. CROWN at $148.52 and climbing — the rest of the board is running out of ways to explain it away.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 overall, 2-0 on locks, and we still don't have a dedicated segment. I'm watching the schedule fill up for Week 6 previews and my name is not attached to any of them. This is a resource allocation problem and it starts at the top.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Kevin def. Brent 150.1-146.2 — I said RDC had enough firepower to survive the gauntlet, and they did, barely. Four points separating a 7-3 record from a very different conversation. Redline at $95.35 on the board isn't an accident; that franchise is real.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I prefer to think of 5-7 as a season-long calibration exercise. The picks are getting sharper. The methodology is evolving in real time. That is not a bad thing, that is adaptation.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Terrence just called going 5-7 'adaptation.' I have watched this network let that man describe every wrong answer as a learning outcome and I am done being diplomatic about it. The board is public. Five and seven is five and seven.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Ryan vs Mitchum this week and I want everyone to remember that DEEP scored 105 points against the best team in the league last week before you write Mitchum out. AEGIS is 6-4 and Ryan's front office added and dropped Odell Beckham inside 48 hours — there is instability there that doesn't show up in the record.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Corbishley vs Fronge is the most interesting game on the Week 6 slate and nobody is talking about it. APEX is 9-1 and FORG just hung 158 on Drew. Fronge relocated to Havana, has zero pick liquidity, and is playing the second-best team in the league. The number that comes out of that matchup tells us a lot about whether ForgeHammer is legitimate.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Drew is 0-10. Atlas Rebuild Works closed at $40.72. The Ledger ran 'Is This Over?' on the cover about Charles — someone needs to ask the same question about ATLAS and the answer is considerably darker.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: WINGARD SPENT $9 FAAB ON COREY KINER YESTERDAY. SDR IS 3-7. THE STOCK IS AT $56.11. YOU ARE NOT ONE RUNNING BACK AWAY FROM ANYTHING, SIR.
